data.name: Gigafex
data.description: Gigafex helps palm oil mills turn EFB biomass into biochar and scientifically verifiable carbon removal credits using proprietary, patent-pending pyrolysis reactors purpose-built for EFB biomass that integrate into existing mill operations at industrial scale. The company positions biochar as both a carbon removal product and a soil amendment for regenerative agriculture. It is backed by F4 Fund.
